facts.business: Nutech Global Limited produces 4.01 million meters of quality fabric per year, diversified into suiting, shirting, ready-made garments, dress material (uniform), and home furnishing.
key_risks: Competitive risk (domestic and international markets, pricing pressures, online trades, fast fashion)
Raw material price risk (Polyester, Viscose, P/V blended yarn, Cotton Yarn)
Human resources risk (retaining talent, attracting new manpower)
facts.related_party_note: There were no materially significant transactions with related parties during the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026 that may have potential conflict with the interest of the Company at large. All transactions with related parties were at arm's length basis.
